comment: Intel 80286 (1982) — 80186 + 13 system instructions reachable via 0x0F escape prefix. Phase 26 ships REAL-MODE only; the system instructions exist in the spec but their semantic implementations are no-op-ish (LMSW/SMSW touch a real MSW register; the descriptor-related ones (LGDT/LIDT/LLDT/LTR/...) store/load to dedicated state slots without enforcing any of the protected-mode invariants those slots would gate. Phase 27 will implement protected mode end-to-end on top of this scaffold.
comment_register_file: Sprint 27.1 — full register_file declared inline (instead of inheriting the 8086 file via the empty-placeholder mechanism) to add the MSW status register. Future schema enhancement (register_file_diff) would make this less verbose; the inline approach gets MSW landed today without blocking on the schema work.

status.name: MSW
status.comment: Sprint 27.1 — Machine Status Word. Bit 0 PE (protected enable), bit 1 MP (math present), bit 2 EM (emulation), bit 3 TS (task switched). Reset value 0xFFF0 per Intel 80286 PRM (top 4 bits stuck set in real mode). LMSW writes the low 16 bits; SMSW reads them.

status.name: GDTR_LIMIT
status.comment: Sprint 27.2 — Global Descriptor Table Register limit (16-bit). LGDT writes both LIMIT + BASE; SGDT reads. Reset undefined per Intel; we init 0xFFFF for safety.

status.name: GDTR_BASE
status.comment: Sprint 27.2 — GDTR base address. 80286 uses low 24 bits; stored in 32-bit slot for layout consistency. LGDT byte 5 of m48 is reserved/zero on 286.

status.name: IDTR_LIMIT
status.comment: Sprint 27.2 — Interrupt Descriptor Table Register limit. Same shape as GDTR_LIMIT.

status.name: IDTR_BASE
status.comment: Sprint 27.2 — IDTR base address. Same shape as GDTR_BASE.

status.name: LDTR
status.comment: Sprint 27.3 — Local Descriptor Table register. 16-bit selector (real-mode is just an opaque 16-bit value; Phase 27b protected-mode dereferences it through GDT). LLDT writes; SLDT reads. Reset = 0.

status.name: TR
status.comment: Sprint 27.3 — Task Register selector. Same shape as LDTR. LTR writes; STR reads. Reset = 0.

variants.notes: Intel 80286 — 80186 + 13 system instructions (0x0F-escape encoding). Phase 26 v1: real-mode only. Protected mode (descriptor tables, privilege levels, TSS task switching) deferred to Phase 27.
